reviewer_notes.text: INTERIM SOLO REVIEW by the author of the change, pending independent re-review: the reviewer seat is out (owner decision 31 Oct 2026). I read the text of pull request 319 and the QL-1.02 spec. The three metric criteria of task T2 (survived == 0, mutants > 0, ignored == 0) say they judge T2's own change to src/engine/contracts.mjs and src/engine/mutation-lint.mjs, but their cmd named no --scope, so a run from the contract's base also judged task 1's runner (src/engine/mutation-gate.mjs) against test files that never exercise it, and survived == 0 could not hold for a correct T2. T2's own requirement allows the canonical command with --scope and each of the task's scope globs before --json. Checked by comparing the two snapshots: exactly the three cmd fields differ; in each the new cmd is the old cmd with 7 --scope flags added before --json, and those flags are exactly T2's scope globs (src/engine/contracts.mjs, docs/CONTRACTS.md, test/gate-mutate-lint.test.mjs, test/helpers/**, docs/MODULES.md, changelog.d/QL-1.02.md, src/engine/mutation-lint.mjs), in the order of the scope list; statement, type, key, op, value and timeout_s are unchanged. This carries out a form the spec already allows and judges the same lines it names, so I do not read it as a loosened metric. This is a solo review by the author and has not been independently checked.
